title: When Cottrell used the folding drum; his cymbals and snare
summary: Around 1923-25 with the Piron band; Frazier recalls Zildjian cymbals and a four-inch shell snare.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: About what time was he using this drum? Do you remember about the year?
That year, yeah. I remember that. That was around in, let's see, 23, 23. I was thinking about around 1925 like that. Yeah.
That was when he was playing with Piron?
Piron Band, that's the only one.
So he used that drum when he was playing with Piron?
He used it on all of his jobs, did he?

Most likely, I wouldn't say all of them, but every time I seen him, he used it. Now, what did he ever use when he was working at Tranchina's nightclub, that old Spanish food? I don't know what kind of drums he's using out there, you know.
Do you remember what kind of cymbals he used at all, Louis Petron?
Do you remember what kind of snare drum? I guess you don't remember that.
Well, I wouldn't remember the snare drum he used. No, it was... All I know, it was what you call them, they say, about a four-inch shell snare drum.
